text:
miguel r: Quick q from onboarding week — trying to sort taxes/benefits before first payroll :wave:

miguel r: 1) Where do I upload my completed W-4 and state tax forms? I didn't see it in the onboarding checklist.

linda z: hey miguel — welcome! :tada:

linda z: Upload federal + state tax forms to the HR portal: https://redwood.example/hr-portal -> Documents -> Tax Forms. We need them before payroll cutoff to apply for this pay period.

miguel r: got it. what's the payroll cutoff day? also how long until 401(k) eligibility? interested in auto-enroll.

hr-ops: Payroll cutoff is Tuesday 5pm PT the week of payday. First payroll after start date will be included if forms are in by cutoff. 401(k) eligibility: you are eligible after 60 days of employment; auto-enroll at 5% unless you opt out. Plan docs: https://redwood.example/401k.

miguel r: thanks. If I want to opt in earlier for employer match does that happen automatically on eligibility date or do I need to sign up?

linda z: you need to enroll in the 401(k) portal before the eligibility date to set your deferral. Employer match begins the first payroll after eligibility and is retroactive to your first eligible paycheck if enrolled within 30 days of eligibility.

miguel r: perfect. another thing — I had moving expenses (mileage + shipping) while relocating. Is moving expense reimbursable? What's the code?

tom a: moving expenses are not typically reimbursed unless pre-approved under a relocation offer. If you had a negotiated relocation allowance, submit under expense category "relocation" with receipts. If not, submit a ticket to people-ops and attach your offer email.

miguel r: mine had a note saying "partial relocation stipend" but no details. I'll submit and tag @linda z. Any special fields in the expense form?

hr-ops: Use the Expenses form, category "relocation". Required fields: amount, receipt(s), date, notes referencing the offer (copy or screenshot). If you're unsure, include the offer letter in the ticket.

payroll-bot: Expense submitted: MIG-2025-045 by miguel r. Status: pending manager approval.

miguel r: last q — company holidays list? do they pro-rate floating holidays for mid-year hires?

linda z: 2025 holiday calendar is posted: https://redwood.example/holidays. Floating holidays are pro-rated based on hire date; policy excerpt: "floating holiday accrual = (full-year floating days) * (days remaining in year / 365)". HR can give exact amount if you DM me your start date.

miguel r: start date 2025-07-14 — can you DM the pro-rated amount? thanks!

linda z: will do. Welcome aboard again :rocket:
